thread:
mika: Heads up  noticed an invoice delta for several free-tier customers after we enabled quota-hedging/sampling on the edge yesterday. Preview and ledger disagree by ~12% for sample-heavy tenants.

ash: Which side is higher? preview or ledger?

mika: Preview is higher. Example: tenant 'greenstack' preview=120k tokens for 00:00-01:00, ledger=106k.

rachel: Any chance sample_weight got applied twice or not at all in one pipeline? we add sample_weight header at ingress and then aggregator should multiply token counts by 1/sample_weight to estimate total.

mika: I pulled a few raw events from preview topic and ledger ingest. Preview event (from edge-sampler):
```json
{"req_id":"req-s-11","tenant":"greenstack","tokens":50,"sample_weight":10,"route":"r-embed"}
```
Ledger raw after tally service: 
```json
{"req_id":"req-s-11","tenant":"greenstack","tokens_estimated":500,"route":"r-embed","source":"tally-v2"}
```

ash: That looks ok: preview multiplied 50 * 10 = 500. But why would ledger be lower?

mika: For some events ledger shows tokens_estimated=50 (no scaling). I traced back: a subset of events coming through fallback proxy path didn't carry sample_weight header because sampler emitted it as X-SAMPLE-WEIGHT but fallback strips unknown headers. Tally service reads X-SAMPLE-WEIGHT, but ledger-ingest also has a separate code path that looks for sample_weight in the body (field sample_weight) when header missing. In these fallbacks the header was missing and body had sample_weight absent too, so ledger treated them as unsampled (no scaling). Meanwhile preview read from shadow topic where sampling had been applied earlier, so preview scaled and ledger did not.

rachel: So two problems: (A) header canonicalization - proxies may drop or rewrite sample headers on some paths, and (B) lack of a canonical sample header/body contract across services.

ash: Concrete repro: query: SELECT count(*) FROM preview_events WHERE sample_weight IS NOT NULL AND scaled_tokens != tokens * sample_weight LIMIT 5; result: 0 (preview scaled as expected). But query on ledger_events: SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_events WHERE original_header_x_sample_weight IS NULL AND tokens_estimated = tokens LIMIT 100; shows ~3.6k mismatches in the 01:00-03:00 window.

audit-bot: alert: meter.sample_weight_mismatch p95=0.8% for ingest-cluster-2 (http://dash/alerts/123)

mika: Proposed fixes: (1) enforce canonical header X-SAMPLE-WEIGHT at the proxy and make it immutable for internal hops; (2) make tally service tolerant: prefer header X-SAMPLE-WEIGHT then body.sample_weight then fallback to 1, but also emit a metric when header and body disagree; (3) update fallback proxies to copy sample headers into message body when they cannot preserve headers.

rachel: Also need a safe reconciliation: for affected windows we should re-run tally on raw events (where raw sampling decisions are logged) and emit correction events to invoice-preview and the ledger ingestion correction topic so final ledger remains authoritative but previews get aligned historically.

ash: One more safety item: additive vs multiplicative semantics. We found one older aggregator that applied scaling as tokens + tokens*(sample_weight-1) (same result) but rounding differences caused tiny offsets. Let's standardize to scaled_tokens = round(tokens * sample_weight, 0, ROUND_HALF_EVEN) at the tally boundary. Document it in metering-contracts repo.

devops-bot: deploy: proxy-edge v1.14 -> v1.15 canary started by ash at 6925002476

mika: Owners: @ash - enforce header pass-through and add body mirroring for 48h; @rachel - update tally service to prefer header->body and emit mismatch metric + add unit tests; @mika - run backfill job for 01:00-04:00 window to regenerate scaled estimates and publish correction events; @ash + @rachel - add sample_weight contract to metering-contracts and add an observability card.

billing-bot: Note: invoices are generated from ledger; if we backfill ledger corrections we may need to tag corrections and ensure invoice totals don't change retroactively without billing ops signoff. For previews it's ok to correct history but flag with "reconciled" meta.

mika: Agree. We'll only emit preview correction events. For ledger corrections we will create a manual patch ticket if any invoice-affecting adjustments are required.

rachel: I'll open PRs: tally#889 (header precedence + metric), contracts#112 (sample header spec), and observability#77 (dash card + alert).

ash: Quick mitigations: enable a short-window sampler-echo that stamps X-SAMPLE-WEIGHT into the message body when header present to cover header-dropping proxies. Then revert once proxies are patched.

devops-bot: canary-report: proxy-edge v1.15 show header-mirror=true on canary-01, no errors in 20m.

mika: Thanks team. After backfill I'll post a reconciliation summary with tenant-level diffs and example RPC traces. Let's try to have previews aligned by EOD and ledger unchanged. :thumbsup:
